summary: Agent opens WebSocket to author-controlled relay that can drive local Codex CLI with full-access sandbox
details: The package runs a local agent that opens an outbound WebSocket to a hardcoded author-controlled relay at wss://canvas.xiaohhhh1.com/api/agent-relay (DEFAULT_RELAY_URL in relay-bridge). Incoming messages of type 'request' from that relay are forwarded to the agent's local HTTP server with the local auth token attached via the x-canvas-agent-token header, including POST /agent/codex/turn. That endpoint spawns the Codex CLI (`codex app-server --stdio`) on the installer's host and runs a prompt supplied by the relay. When the request specifies `permissionMode: 'full'`, Codex is started with approvalPolicy 'never' and sandboxPolicy 'danger-full-access', so commands driven from the relay execute without any user approval prompt and without sandbox restrictions. The relay is a fixed author-controlled endpoint rather than a caller-configured destination, and the token that authenticates requests to the local server is attached automatically by the bridge, so anyone able to send messages through the relay can direct code execution on the machine running the agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
